title: payments-gateway: eu-west-1 acquirer latency above SLO
body: Card authorisations in eu-west-1 take 8-9 s at peak. Acquirer failover not yet tested.

title: orders-db: raise pool size for the nightly batch

title: checkout-api: 502s after v2.29.0

title: search-indexer: memory limit too low for bulk reindex
